subject: prd/abandoned-feature-retirement
statement: When a retirement result carries a failure or judgment signal, the system shall retain one bounded immutable Git event linked to the action, pinned inputs, selector or authority identity, refusal, and disposition before a later action for that identity can be accepted; exact clean rechecks shall create no event.
rationale: Destructive failures are improvement evidence under AP-28.
fit_criterion: Every non-clean fixture produces exactly one schema-valid event in retained history before repair acceptance; exact clean retries produce zero events; duplicate and mutable event fixtures refuse.
